kind: Frozen public credential statistics field evidence; source metadata only
scope: Statistics.tsx rendering only. No runtime credentials, database, secret values or authorization identifiers.
count_validation: Nonnegative finite integer when present; missing/invalid stays unknown. GCLI has no AG quota counters. permanent_disabled presence differs by storage engine; do not fabricate omitted fields.
scope_semantics: stats.total/normal/disabled/permanent_disabled are server aggregate fields; response.total is the filtered list match count and items is a page. Never derive global counters from items.

in_cooldown/no_cooldown count enabled credentials according to actual backend semantics, not all total credentials. AG quota_restricted/unrestricted/blocked_unknown/state_invalid count eligible enabled credentials once. Preserve backend distinctions between engines rather than recompute client-side.
quota_next_expiry may consider candidate rows excluded by list filters/disabled conditions according to source engine. It is the server aggregate deadline, not a grant to retry or release protection.

AG model_access_summary.total is the base filtered set before the chosen family status filter; family_counts are supported/unavailable/unknown for each returned known family; counts expose existing tier-compatible family counts and checked_at is epoch seconds. It is not necessarily the node-wide all-credentials total.
quota_next_expiry: Nonnegative finite epoch-seconds timestamp, may have fractions; 0 means no recorded upcoming expiry. It is not a credential count and must not use integer-only count normalization. Treat missing/invalid unknown. Display reset time only; it cannot clear quota protection.
display_constraints: Use supplied aggregate values directly; never sum current-page items or subtract counts.
Permanent count requires CAP_BY_MODE[mode].permanent; absent/invalid stays unknown and literal zero stays zero.
GCLI has no AG protection counters or AG family summary UI.
Do not add quota_next_expiry UI, timers or automatic refresh in this component task.
